priorFindingDispositions.title: Direct delivery write access violates the assurance pull/copy boundary
directEvidence: 5-coding-r4/infra/modules/assurance/main.bicep:132-147 scopes the separately controlled evidence reader-copier write assignment to the assurance evidence container.
5-coding-r4/infra/parameters/prd.bicepparam:3455-3457 binds the copier authority to Internal Audit and the exact container data role; deliveryPrincipalId is absent.
5-coding-r4/tests/iac/Invoke-DeploymentPreflight.ps1:849-867 rejects deliveryPrincipalId and enforces the exact role, authority and separate service principal.
priorFindingDispositions.residualBoundary: Exact source-container read and evidence pull/copy acceptance remain owner-bound under CC1-OWN-002; no production evidence admission is authorised.

priorFindingDispositions.title: Declared locked immutability and legal hold are not implemented
directEvidence: 5-coding-r4/infra/parameters/prd.bicepparam:3406-3414 records blocked retention finalisation, dataAdmissionEnabled false and empty observed-evidence bindings.

5-coding-r4/deploy/Invoke-AssuranceRetentionFinalization.ps1:75-210 requires -Execute, a hashed Phase 7 authorisation, policy ETags, lock and legal-hold operations, observed Locked state and legal-hold tag verification.
5-coding-r4/tests/iac/Invoke-DeploymentPreflight.ps1:820-847 fails closed unless the separately authorised observed evidence IDs and hashes are bound.
priorFindingDispositions.residualBoundary: The irreversible procedure was not executed and no lock, legal hold or operating effectiveness is claimed; admission remains blocked until observed evidence is independently accepted.

priorFindingDispositions.title: Workload NSGs and routes retain fail-open Azure defaults
directEvidence: 5-coding-r4/infra/parameters/prd.bicepparam:3-140 defines service-specific workload allow rules, explicit deny-all inbound/outbound rules and regional firewall default routes.
5-coding-r4/infra/modules/network/main.bicep:10-80 handles Azure-reserved subnets, attaches workload NSGs/routes and applies privateEndpointNetworkPolicies.
5-coding-r4/tests/iac/Invoke-DeploymentPreflight.ps1:391-480 rejects empty controls, missing denies, regional-firewall route mismatches and disabled private-endpoint policies.
priorFindingDispositions.residualBoundary: Owner-supplied network values remain fail-closed sentinels and require authorised target validation in Phase 7.

priorFindingDispositions.title: Service Bus RBAC is over-broad and incompatible with the runtime
directEvidence: 5-coding-r4/infra/modules/integration/main.bicep:8-99 defines seven exact producer/consumer paths and assigns roles at Microsoft.ServiceBus/namespaces/queues scope.
5-coding-r4/infra/modules/application-platform/main.bicep:7-14 and 152 deploy only ingestion, extraction and indexing workers.
5-coding-r4/tests/iac/Invoke-DeploymentPreflight.ps1:377-389 and 496-546 verifies the exact queue-scoped map and rejects deployment of analysis or audit-export workers.
priorFindingDispositions.residualBoundary: Analysis and audit-export interfaces remain authority-blocked and have no active worker or Service Bus data-plane RBAC.

priorFindingDispositions.title: Container Apps authentication is not bound to an Entra tenant and audience
directEvidence: 5-coding-r4/infra/modules/application-platform/main.bicep:119-149 configures platform auth, Return401, HTTPS, no excluded paths and exact tenant/client/audience bindings using the Azure cloud authentication endpoint.

5-coding-r4/infra/modules/apim-lockdown/main.bicep:27-75 strips spoofable platform identity/token headers, validates the Authorization bearer JWT against tenant issuer/audience and preserves it to the backend without authentication-managed-identity replacement.

5-coding-r4/tests/iac/Invoke-DeploymentPreflight.ps1:549-594 requires APIM and Container Apps bindings to match; app/src/api-runtime.ts:283-364 defensively requires AAD, tenant-consistent issuer, roles and human identity for human-only operations.
priorFindingDispositions.residualBoundary: Tenant, client and audience values remain owner-bound. Cloud and target behaviour require separately authorised Phase 7 validation; no runtime authentication claim is made.

priorFindingDispositions.title: Release evidence suppresses open authority conflicts and residual controls
directEvidence: 5-coding-r4/stratton-release-manifest.json records exactly three authorityConflicts, fourteen unresolvedControls and two retainedMinorGaps.
5-coding-r4/validation/Test-ReleaseEvidence.ps1:148-182 validates the exact lists; stratton-build-report.md:77-103 renders the same disclosure.
priorFindingDispositions.residualBoundary: All disclosed authority conflicts, fourteen owner controls and two retained AFF-B minor gaps remain open, fail closed and unwaived.
